verdict.rationale: Docs claim strong cloud-agent autonomy: kicking off long-running tasks on web/mobile, cloud sessions, working on repos not local, writing/testing code across files, opening PRs, and even routing Slack bug reports to PRs (claude-code-docs-1,2,3,10,11,13,14,16). But community evidence reports frequent failure to self-verify, destructive edits, and degraded end-to-end reliability over extended autonomous runs (claude-code-comm-16,17,19,20), and that Claude is a better reviewer than implementer, requiring multiple correction rounds (claude-code-comm-18) — casting doubt on 'build, test, demo' being reliably end-to-end without human intervention.
